asset_ownership_interpretation: Current first-party help material states users authorize CoinDCX to deploy supported assets on their behalf, but the reviewed sources do not establish a universal legal-title, segregation, trust or insolvency-priority model for Earn balances. Legacy DCX Lend terms are not generalized to current Earn.
notes: Variable rates, minimum holding periods, early-exit consequences, service-change discretion and partial/complete-loss risk are preserved as current product terms. Displayed rates are not treated as guaranteed or realized returns.
